name: knowledge-base
description: Read-only retrieval from the repository-authored Markdown corpus shipped with this plugin. Browse chapters, sections, and source-linked entries.

interface.shortDescription: Browse the shipped read-only Markdown corpus in stages.
interface.longDescription: Reads the tracked Markdown corpus shipped with the plugin and returns chapter, section, summary, and full-content views separately. Author updates by editing tracked entries; publication remains subject to the repository's source/storage review.
defaultPrompt: Search the knowledge base and retrieve one selected entry.
